office: Abbot of the monastery of Augarus

names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 9 ianuarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Ευστράτιος ο Θαυματουργός», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 9 января ст. ст., «Евстратий Тарсийский, игумен», with the office left off. The calendar's epithet is from Tarsus, where its own notice says he was born, and not from the mountain where he lived.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life gives no year for him, only reigns: he left his monastery when «Leon Armeanul (813-820)» revived the heresy against the icons, and returned «după ce Biserica iarăși și-a luat podoaba sa prin așezarea și închinarea la sfintele icoane», dying later at ninety-five. 820 is therefore a lower bound and the page gives no upper one.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 января ст. ст. — «Прп. Евстратия чудотворца (821).»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Ιανουαρίου — «Όσιος Ευστράτιος ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs and the Ohrid Prologue for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
